questions.prompt: Which of the following words is similar to CONSIDER?
questions.explanation: Both "consider" and "reflect" mean to think about something.

questions.prompt: BRING APART means:
questions.explanation: Both "bring apart" and "disconnect" mean to make a thing or things come apart.

questions.prompt: Which of the following words is opposite to SUPERIOR?
questions.explanation: "Inferior" is the opposite of "superior": it means lower in rank, quality, value or importance. There is no such word as "unferior".

questions.prompt: What is another word for REQUIRED?
questions.explanation: Both "required" and "needed" describe something that is compulsory or not optional.

questions.prompt: WINTER is to SNOW as SPRING is to:
questions.explanation: Snow is a feature of winter, and blossom is a feature of spring.

questions.prompt: KIND is to KINDEST as MEAN is to:
questions.explanation: "Kindest" is "kind" with "-est" added, so "mean" with "-est" added is "meanest".

questions.prompt: LIBRARIAN is to LIBRARY as TEACHER is to:
questions.explanation: A librarian works in a library; a teacher works in a school. "School" is not an option, so the answer is "none of these".

questions.prompt: FOOTBALL is to FIELD as SKI is to:
questions.explanation: Football is played on a field; skiing is done on the slopes.

questions.prompt: PARENT is to CARE as TEACHER is to:
questions.explanation: A parent's role is care; a teacher's role is education.

questions.prompt:
Select TWO options which together most strongly suggest that:
CHRISTINE HAS A DOG AND A CAT.
1: Christine has two pets.
2: Christine does not have two cats.
3: Molly has 1 dog; Peter has 1 cat.
4: Christine has the same pets as both Molly and Peter.
5: Christine does not have a pet bird.
questions.explanation: Statements 3 and 4 together prove it: Molly has one dog, Peter has one cat, and Christine has the same pets as both. But "3 & 4" is not offered, so the answer is "none of these".

questions.prompt:
Select TWO options which together most strongly suggest that:
JILL PLAYS BASKETBALL ON MONDAY.
1: Jill plays basketball and netball.
2: Kathy plays basketball on Monday.
3: Today is Monday.
4: Jill is in the same basketball team as Kathy.
5: Kathy and Jill are best friends.
questions.explanation: If Kathy plays basketball on Monday (2) and Jill is in the same basketball team as Kathy (4), then Jill also plays basketball on Monday.

questions.prompt:
Select TWO options which together most strongly suggest that:
JANET WENT TO THE PARK ON TUESDAY.
1: Janet lives next to a park.
2: The park is big and has many pieces of play equipment.
3: Lindsay and her best friend went to the park on Tuesday.
4: Janet likes to play on the slide and the swing set.
5: Janet is Lindsay's best friend.
questions.explanation: If Lindsay and her best friend went to the park on Tuesday (3), and Janet is Lindsay's best friend (5), then Janet went to the park on Tuesday.

questions.prompt: Four of the following words are alike in some way. Which of the following words is the odd one out?
questions.explanation: Skill, knowledge, expertise and wisdom all describe types of intelligence. "Brain" is an organ, so it is the odd one out.

questions.prompt: Four of the following words are alike in some way. Which of the following words is the odd one out?
questions.explanation: Australia, the United States, China and India are countries. London is a city.

questions.prompt: Four of the following words are alike in some way. Which of the following words is the odd one out?
questions.explanation: Boat, ship, vessel and yacht are all types of water transport. A paddle is not.

questions.prompt:
The red balloon is smaller than the blue balloon. The yellow balloon is smaller than the blue balloon but bigger than the pink balloon.
If the pink balloon is bigger than the red balloon, which is the third biggest balloon?
questions.explanation: From biggest to smallest the order is blue, yellow, pink, red, so the third biggest is pink.

questions.prompt:
Brett's watch is fifteen minutes fast, but the alarm clock in his bedroom is 10 minutes slow. Brett has a very important meeting at work today so he cannot leave his house any later than 8.45 am (real time).
Brett's watch says 7.20 am, therefore what is the real time and the time on his alarm clock?
questions.explanation: The watch is 15 minutes fast, so if it says 7.20 am the real time is 7.05 am. The alarm clock is 10 minutes slow, so it reads 6.55 am.

questions.prompt:
Six children swam in a race. Chloe finished in front of Matt and Chris but behind Joey. Chris beat Mandy (who finished before Lucy) but swam slower than Matt and Chloe.
Who came fifth in the race?
questions.explanation: The order from first to last is Joey, Chloe, Matt, Chris, Mandy, Lucy, so fifth is Mandy.

questions.prompt:
Fred has five different school jumpers. Each jumper is a different colour. He wears his blue jumper on Wednesdays and his orange jumper 2 days before his blue jumper. His red jumper is worn 2 days before his green jumper, which is one day after his blue jumper. Finally, Fred wears his black jumper 4 days after his orange jumper.
What colour jumper does Fred wear on Fridays?
questions.explanation: Monday = orange, Tuesday = red, Wednesday = blue, Thursday = green, Friday = black.

questions.prompt:
Beth owns five teddy bears. Only one does not have a hat, and all bears but one are brown. 'Mr Ted' is new and 'Mr Cole' (who does not have a hat) wears a green bow tie. 'Miss Daisy-bear' does not wear a bow tie, and 'Miss Black bear' (named after her colour) sits between 'Mrs Bear' (who wears a hat) and 'Miss Daisy-bear'.
The first bear Beth chooses to play with is an old brown bear wearing a bow tie and a hat. What is the name of this bear?
questions.explanation: It is not Mr Ted (he is new), not Mr Cole (no hat), not Miss Daisy-bear (no bow tie) and not Miss Black bear (not brown). So the bear is Mrs Bear.
